title: Balance suite cascades from the wrong database port
root_cause: The runner publishes PostgreSQL on host port 5432, but DATABASE_URL points to localhost port 5433. The 24 test setup errors are cascading symptoms of the shared fixture's refused database connection, rather than separate test regressions.

relevant_evidence.why: The service publishes port 5432 on the host.
The connection URL instead uses host port 5433.
Every test using db connects through DATABASE_URL.
The fixture reports a refused connection to port 5433.
The suite reports 24 setup errors and fails.
